test_title: PYST 10: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one that follows the same logic.

GEAN - NAGE - GAEN

MAKE - EKMA - MKAE
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/370f86c20f3decb4f69fa198f9054925b1c11d3bb860547436e5f77ef76556e9.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, GEAN - NAGE - GAEN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bab48068e9e84eeec2dc5d1d4e67164a8d07a3257375ca125a3a65f1cb14d7f.png] 

For, MAKE - EKMA - MKAE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5afee70b620f9fa68e70b3397cf8b148e412e4ddb1eb60ce1e81c197ea09fb5e.png] 

Similarly,

FOWL - LWFO - FWOL 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f360783c385b107fa00201436ce7e95bbd43db7ff45984cf379e9187d2a89425.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
